title: 第11章 故意伤害案

第11章 故意伤害案
“小王也是很喜欢捣鼓电脑软件的。以前咱们县来了协查的案子，都是小王安排着弄的。”老严为小王做了个背书，顺便为本县唯二的痕检正名。
王钟却是羞涩一笑，谦虚的道：“我那个跟江法医做的没法比，你是硬桥硬马的做指纹的，我主要就是跑一下指纹库。”
指纹库是不断更新的，而负责更新的主体，主要就是各地的痕检民警。他们负责将采集到的指纹拍照，归档，填写说明，有时候还需要进行人工处理，再放入指纹库中。另外，采用计算机系统以前的旧案指纹，也需要人工核检等操作，才能入库。
时不时的把旧案的指纹拿出来跑一跑，就是跑库的一种。以前匹配不到的嫌疑人，说不定哪天出个酒驾或者斗殴，就被匹配了。甚至犯罪嫌疑人办了个暂住证之类的，都可能让孤单的指纹得到了配对，可谓是成人之美。
此外，有的人在外地犯了罪，在当地的指纹库找不到配对，却有可能在外地的指纹库留有指纹信息，这种指纹不见得就复杂，很多时候，做痕检的民警收到协查函，用最传统的模式大略的标一下特征点，接着跑指纹库，有枣没枣的打两杆，也可能比中。
跑库也是大部分普通痕检民警的日常了，江远若是没有系统的话，头几年能跑库就不错了，因此，他是和煦而真诚的道：“不管白猫黑猫，逮到老鼠就是好猫。”
王钟顿时觉得江远这个年轻人不错，能处，于是更加自谦的做起了比喻：“在逮老鼠方面，你是狸花猫，我最多就是只布偶猫。”
在场众人看看王钟常年出现场和熬夜而皮肤粗糙的脸颊，再看看白净斯文的江远，陷入了委婉的沉思中。
“你刚说有个案子？”吴军提醒了一句。
“对对对。”王钟整理了一下语言，才道：“是个十几年前的旧案，我以前跑库的时候，印象挺深的。案子说起来简单，就是几个高中毕业生喝散伙酒，喝醉了，跟一名过路的年轻人发生了冲突，结果被人拎起凳子给打翻了，倒霉的是挨打的学生被打瞎了一只眼睛，这就成了致人重伤。”
“伱说瞎了一只眼，我就记得了。那时候高考还是7月份考，分数下来的时候，天气正热呢，到处都是喝了啤酒闹事的学生。当年大学录取率又低，没地方去的学生，还有复读生到处找茬。最严重的就是这个案子，挨打的学生还是个优等生，考了个大专。估计挨打也是这个原因。”吴法医回忆往昔，颇有感慨：“还是我师父给做的司法鉴定。”
“是这个案子，当时猜测嫌疑人可能是过来玩的外地学生，也有可能是来打工的，出了事就跑走了。”小王点头。
十几年前对严革略有些远了，他也没看过档案，直接问：“没起个专案组吗？”
“县里成立了专案组，但主要还是寻访排查，最后也没锁定嫌疑人。”
“市里呢。”
“没进市。”
“当年还没搞下沉，清河市局基本不做业务。”吴军给解释了一句。早些年，省厅和市局都是做业务指导，而非直接做业务的。说的通俗点，它们是不直接办案的。
比如省厅，总计才几百人的编制，就是大案要案，也是办不过来的，甚至日常工作都需要借调下面区县的人，不如直接把案件放到区县，自己做点技术和组织工作。
市局的人手紧张程度略好一点，这些年也被要求下沉，直接办案等等，但对安平市乃至山南省这种落后地区来说，要求归要求，实际归实际。

所以，不仅十几年前的故意伤人案到不了市局，就是现在，重伤案也得有极大的影响，才会组织市一级的专案组。当然，若是换成命案的话，那又是两说了。
“指纹线索也有问题。”小王接着做介绍，道：“当时从嫌疑人用做凶器的凳子腿上提取了指纹，但凳子腿是圆形钢管做的……”
“哦……”严革和江远齐齐露出恍然的表情。圆柱体痕迹的拍照提取，向来是刑侦现勘的一大难题，弯曲的形状使得指纹的变形严重，弯曲的表面使得拍照时的反光严重……虽然取指纹还是取得到，但指纹的完整度和准确度都要大打折扣。
“当年取指纹，估计是用分段拍摄法固定的，形变肯定不小……”严革猜测了一句，又感慨道：“我们那时候还去培训什么辅助圆柱体表面展开方式的拍摄，就是一个专门的机器，一边转圈一边拍摄，最后还只有省城买了，想用得打几道申请，现在好了，手机
江远哑然失笑，顺手在电脑上
嫌疑人留下的四枚指纹，很快出现在了屏幕上，几个人都勾着头看了起来。
只几秒钟的功夫，严革和王钟都放弃了希望。
图像的清晰程度尚可，但断点较多，不用说，判断起来一定是困难重重的。最主要的是，指纹的左右两侧，有明显的外延，变形部位的纹线明显变宽变粗了，如此一来，必须首先对图像做变形，然后再标记指纹，论起难度来，绝对是高阶要求了。
就严革判断，别说他和小王了，就是送到市里甚至省里，能不能出结果，也是难说。
王钟从跑库开始，就有关注这个案子，此时兴致勃勃的道：“这个案子的好处是，凶器上的指纹，除了这几枚连续的指纹以外，都已经排除了。另外，当初还请了画像师，给嫌疑人画了像，虽然过了这么些年了，但有指纹有画像，应该还是比较好确认的。”
在场诸人不由点头。这确实是一个优势，能够通过指纹破获的积案，数量本身就有限，能直接定罪就更不容易了。再加上有画像，有当事人和目击证人，真要是比中了指纹，直接就可以抓人结案了。
当然，一切的前提是能比中指纹。
老严和小王，包括吴军都看向了江远。
江远不觉笑了一下。
“看来，江远是有把握啊。”小王突然有点羡慕江远。
“我做着试试看。”江远笑的主要原因，是嫌犯留下的指纹恰巧是弓型纹，若非如此，他说不得还得把此案推脱出去。
至于难度，就他这两日做指纹的体会来说，似乎也在射程之内。只是不太可能一蹴而就罢了。
吴军这时候哈哈一笑，道：“破案归破案，休息归休息，今天就别着急了，反正都是积案了，也不差这一天两天的……”
他是故意打断的。不管怎么说，严革和王鹏都是队里的专业痕检民警，江远却是法医，还是他的徒弟。让两名痕检民警看着江远一个小年轻做指纹，总不是个事。
“确实，你们这两天弄尸体估计也累坏了，悠着来。”严革也是哈哈一笑，拉着王钟走了。

吴军等人出门了，端起茶杯喝口水，对江远道：“甭着急了，马上就午休时间了，该收拾收拾，该吃饭吃饭，你今天要不要再炒个饭？”
江远也确实不着急，问：“队里的食堂可以自己炒饭吗？”
吴军摆摆手：“用不着找他们，警犬中队也有厨房。”
江远：..
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 11 Intentional Injury Case
"Xiao Wang also likes tinkering with computer software. In the past, the cases our county came to assist in the investigation were arranged by Xiao Wang." Lao Yan endorsed Xiao Wang, and by the way, he rectified the name of the only trace inspection company in the county.
Wang Zhong smiled shyly and said modestly: "I can't compare with what forensic doctor Jiang does. You are the one who does the hard work of doing fingerprints. I mainly just run the fingerprint database."
The fingerprint database is constantly updated, and the main body responsible for the update is the trace inspection police in various places. They are responsible for taking photos of the collected fingerprints, filing them, filling in instructions, and sometimes requiring manual processing before placing them in the fingerprint database. In addition, fingerprints from old cases before the use of computer systems also required manual verification and other operations before they could be stored in the database.
From time to time, taking out the fingerprints from old cases and running them is a type of database running. A suspect who could not be matched before may be matched one day due to a drunk driving incident or a fight. Even if the criminal suspect applies for a temporary residence permit, the lonely fingerprints may be matched, which is the beauty of adulthood.
In addition, some people have committed crimes in other places and cannot find a match in the local fingerprint database, but there may be fingerprint information left in the fingerprint database in other places. Such fingerprints are not necessarily complex. In many cases, the police doing the trace inspection receive a co-investigation letter and use the most traditional mode to roughly mark the characteristic points, and then run the fingerprint database. If there are dates but not dates, it is possible to get a double shot.
Running warehouses is also a daily routine for most ordinary trace inspection policemen. If Jiang Yuan didn't have a system, it would be good to be able to run warehouses in the first few years. Therefore, he said warmly and sincerely: "It doesn't matter if the cat is white or black, as long as it catches mice, it is a good cat."
Wang Zhong immediately felt that Jiang Yuan, a young man, was good and capable, so he made an analogy even more modestly: "When it comes to catching mice, you are a raccoon cat, and I am just a ragdoll cat at best."
Everyone present looked at Wang Zhong's rough-skinned cheeks due to his frequent appearances and staying up late, and then at Jiang Yuan, who was fair and elegant, and fell into euphemistic contemplation.
"Did you just say there was a case?" Wu Jun reminded.
"That's right, that's right." Wang Zhong sorted out his words before saying, "It's an old case from more than ten years ago. I had a deep impression on it when I was running a library. The case is simple to say. It was a couple of high school graduates who got drunk and got into a conflict with a young man passing by. As a result, someone picked up a stool and knocked it over. Unfortunately, the student who was beaten was blinded in one eye, which resulted in serious injuries."
"You said I was blind in one eye, so I remember it. At that time, the college entrance examination was still in July. When the scores came out, the weather was hot, and there were students drinking beer and causing trouble everywhere. The college admission rate was low back then, and there were students who had nowhere to go, and there were also complex students Students are looking for trouble everywhere. The most serious case is that the student who was beaten was a top student, and he was probably beaten for this reason." Looking back on the past, forensic doctor Wu said with emotion: "It was my master who did the forensic evaluation."
"It's this case. It was speculated at the time that the suspect might be a student from out of town who came to play, or he might have come to work, and ran away when something happened." Xiao Wang nodded.
More than ten years ago, he was a little far away from Yan Ge. He had not read the files and asked directly: "Didn't a special task force be set up?"
"The county set up a special task force, but it mainly focused on searching and investigating, and in the end the suspect was not identified."
"Where's the city?"
"Not in the market."
"Back then, before the subsidence was implemented, the Qinghe Municipal Bureau basically did not do business." Wu Jun explained. In the early years, the provincial departments and municipal bureaus were responsible for business guidance rather than direct business. To put it simply, they do not handle cases directly.
For example, the provincial department has only a few hundred people in total. Even major cases cannot be handled. Even daily work requires the secondment of people from the districts and counties below. It is better to directly transfer the cases to the districts and counties and do some technical and organizational work on their own.Work.
The municipal bureau's manpower shortage is slightly better. In recent years, it has also been required to move down to handle cases directly, etc. However, for backward areas like Anping City and even Shannan Province, demands are demands and reality is reality.
Therefore, not only were intentional injury cases more than ten years ago unable to reach the city bureau, but even now, serious injury cases must have a huge impact before a city-level task force is organized. Of course, if it were a murder case, that would be a different story.
"There are also problems with fingerprint clues." Xiao Wang continued to introduce, "At that time, fingerprints were extracted from the legs of the stool used by the suspect as the murder weapon, but the legs of the stool were made of round steel pipes..."
"Oh..." Yan Ge and Jiang Yuan both showed surprised expressions. The photo extraction of cylinder traces has always been a major problem in criminal investigation. The curved shape causes serious deformation of fingerprints, and the curved surface causes serious reflection when taking pictures... Although fingerprints can still be obtained, the integrity and accuracy of the fingerprints are greatly reduced.
"When fingerprints were taken back then, they were probably fixed using the segmented shooting method, and the deformation must have been quite large..." Yan Ge guessed, and then said with emotion: "At that time, we also trained on how to assist the shooting of the cylindrical surface unfolding method. It was a special machine that shot while turning in circles. In the end, only the provincial capital bought it. If you want to use it, you have to make a few applications. Now it's fine, with mobile phones
Jiang Yuan laughed dumbly and turned on the computer
The four fingerprints left by the suspect soon appeared on the screen, and several people raised their heads and looked at it.
In just a few seconds, both Yan Ge and Wang Zhong gave up hope.
The clarity of the image is acceptable, but there are many breakpoints. Needless to say, it must be difficult to judge. The most important thing is that there are obvious extensions on the left and right sides of the fingerprint, and the lines in the deformed part have obviously become wider and thicker. As a result, the image must be deformed first, and then the fingerprint can be marked. In terms of difficulty, it is definitely a high-level requirement.
As far as strict judgment is concerned, let alone him and Xiao Wang, even if they are sent to the city or even the province, it is difficult to say whether the results will be obtained.
Wang Zhong has been paying attention to this case since he ran the warehouse, and he said enthusiastically: "The advantage of this case is that, except for these few consecutive fingerprints, all the fingerprints on the murder weapon have been eliminated. In addition, a portrait artist was hired to draw a portrait of the suspect. Although it has been so many years, it should be easier to confirm since there are fingerprints and portraits. "
Everyone present could not help but nod. This is indeed an advantage. The number of backlog cases that can be solved through fingerprints is limited, and it is even more difficult to directly convict. In addition, there are portraits, parties and witnesses. If the fingerprint is really matched, the person can be arrested and the case closed.
Of course, the premise of everything is that the fingerprints can be compared.
Lao Yan, Xiao Wang, and Wu Jun all looked at Jiang Yuan.
Jiang Yuan smiled unconsciously.
"It seems that Jiang Yuan is confident. "Xiao Wang suddenly felt a little envious of Jiang Yuan.
"I'll give it a try. "The main reason why Jiang Yuan laughed was that the fingerprints left by the suspect happened to be bow-shaped patterns. If not, he would have to evade the case.
As for the difficulty, based on his experience of doing fingerprints in the past two days, it seems to be within the range. It’s just unlikely that it will happen overnight.
Wu Jun laughed loudly at this time and said: "If you solve the case, you will solve the case, and if you rest, you will rest. Don't be anxious today. Anyway, there are backlogs of cases, and there is no difference between these two days..."
He interrupted on purpose. In any case, Yan Ge and Wang Peng are both professional trace inspection policemen in the team, but Jiang Yuan is a forensic doctor and his apprentice. It's not easy for two police officers to watch a young man from Jiang Yuan do his fingerprints.
"Indeed, you are probably exhausted from working with corpses these past two days, so take your time. Yan Ge also laughed and pulled Wang Zhong away.
Wu Jun and others went out, took a cup of tea and drank water, and said to Jiang Yuan: "Don't be anxious, it will be lunch break soon.", it’s time to clean up, it’s time to eat, do you want to cook another meal today? "
Jiang Yuan was really not in a hurry and asked, "Can I cook my own rice in the team canteen? "
Wu Jun waved his hand: "No need to look for them, the police dog squadron also has a kitchen. "
Jiang Yuan:...
(End of chapter)
